annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for Chinese recommended national standard GB/T 20867.1-2024, the application specification for industrial robot safety requirements. Issued 2024-08-23, effective 2025-03-01, replacing GB/T 20867-2007. Only metadata, drafters and related standards are shown, not the standard's text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommended national standard GB/T 20867.1-2024 on industrial robot safety application, in force from 2025-03-01
Replaces GB/T 20867-2007 Industrial robot safety implementation rules
Administered by TC591 national robotics standardization committee under the China Machinery Industry Federation
Revision plan underway for whole-machine industrial robot safety standards
Related draft standards cover humanoid robot safety requirements
